outcome: Proportion of SLE pregnancies exposed to specific medications
Discontinuation rates of antimalarials and immunosuppressants
cohort: Women with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) who had singleton pregnancies ending in deliveries in British Columbia, Canada, between 2002 and 2012.
finding: The study found frequent discontinuation of medications, particularly antimalarials, in pregnancies among women with SLE.
